How to win this, 101: 
1. With the cannon balls, you want thick metal that is angled so that it will deflect them and not take the full impact, because a direct impact would likely pierce right through the armor’s wall.
2. To defend against the water mines, you don’t pad the yacht, you pad the around the bombs themselves. Since the mines aren’t close enough to detonate the explosive directly into the hull, your main concern is shrapnel from the bombs, so containing the shrapnel within something that will either deflect or completely stop the shrapnel.
3. Utilize objects that aren’t flammable (which the yacht itself isn’t) and can deflect the arrows and (or absorb the impact of) the fireworks. The main concern is the weight of the projectiles from the trebuchets, which would cause damage, so, use something to deflect them from the yacht, if not building a frame to add a steel sheet over the top of the yacht to protect it. Shipping containers could be used to prevent the other two attacks.
4. Again, use steel objects at an angle to deflect the bullets or fill them with water to slow the bullets drastically before full penetration. For the large mine… uh, well, try your best to prevent the shrapnel from reaching the yacht and maybe use a shipping container as a blast shield.
